notes.about: Expected leg B counts per CIM source, written by census.py --update-expected. Recorded with the cim-dist reader of main plus #680 (transformer tanks). A MAP.UNEXPLAINED count enters this file only with a note below. CODE counts are PowerIO's diagnostics, keyed by code, CIM class and property. Corpus cases are kept when the corpus is absent.
notes.LINECODES derived: Line codes the reader derives rather than takes from a PerLengthImpedance: one per other phase subset of a phase matrix, and one per segment that states its own series impedance or none the reader can use. On IEEE 13 Assets and the 9500 node feeder these are the wire geometry segments (IMPEDANCE_UNRESOLVED), which is why they do not convert to .dss.
